result.title: GeoTex: Geometry-as-Texture Encoding and History-Grounded 4D Occupancy Forecasting
result.summary: 4D occupancy forecasting models 3D scene evolution to support future prediction and scenario generation in autonomous-driving world models. Semantic occupancy abstracts image color and texture into discrete labels, leaving 3D voxel arrangements as the primary cues for distinguishing local shapes within each class. Existing methods borrow image-encoding frameworks to obtain compact latent representations through height channelization or plane factorization, but do not sufficiently model within-column height patterns and cross-column relations jointly before compression, weakening these geometric cues. Forecasting also underutilizes complementary history and struggles to retain reliable observation evidence. We therefore propose GeoTex, an occupancy world model combining geometry-as-texture encoding with history-grounded forecasting. GeoTex Representation jointly encodes within-column height patterns and cross-column relations into compact continuous latent representations and restores 3D structure through content-dependent height unfolding and geometric interaction. GeoTex Prediction retains initial evidence throughout rollout in fixed cross-observation relational memory and incorporates complementary recent history through target-referenced residual updates. After prediction training, decoder-only adaptation improves semantic decoding of predicted states. GeoTex improves average forecasting mIoU and IoU by 9.79% and 11.91% relative to GenieDrive while reducing parameters from 3.47M to 2.33M, with gains increasing at longer horizons. Code is included in the supplementary material.

AI.brief_summary: GeoTex 面向自动驾驶 4D occupancy 预测，将列内高度模式与跨列关系联合编码为紧凑连续潜表示，并在 rollout 中用固定跨观测记忆保留初始观测证据、以目标参照的残差更新融入近期历史，最后做 decoder-only 适配。
AI.relevance_reason: 其压缩前保留几何线索的潜表示、长时程中固定证据记忆与残差式状态更新，可供核查 LVR 中视觉证据保留与 latent 状态更新的设计，但属 occupancy 世界模型而非 VLM 推理，迁移尚属推测。
